subject.title: [codex] fix launchd restart when gateway port is busy

question: Should this PR land as the scoped removal of the macOS LaunchAgent pre-kickstart busy-port gate, or should it wait for direct-caller health proof or unified restart semantics?
rationale: The patch appears correct for the focused bug, but it intentionally changes an availability-sensitive restart precondition and some service.restart callers do not use the normal gateway restart health wrapper.

options.title: Land Scoped Fix
options.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers accept launchd-owned replacement semantics and keep the broader restart/session/update trackers open.

options.title: Require Direct-Caller Proof
options.body: Ask for proof or follow-up coverage showing configure, doctor, update, and start-repair restart callers surface failures when the replacement gateway does not become healthy.

options.title: Pause For Unified Semantics
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want busy-port handling, restart-intent ordering, launchd domain selection, and health proof solved together.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Fix
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks if maintainers accept launchd-owned replacement semantics and keep the broader restart/session/update trackers open.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows repeated launchd lifecycle and gateway recovery work on the affected files, making this the best available routing candidate for the merge-risk choice.
